class SameSourceVersionsEditTest(ServerTestCase):
    """同一来源另存的多个版本：编辑其中一条不应被自己或来源未变挡住。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.first = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·首版",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            duration=243.5,
            cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png",
            description="首版说明",
            tags=["民谣", "现场"],
        )
        self.second = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·重制",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            duration=250,
            cover_url="https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png",
            description="重制说明",
            tags=["民谣", "重制"],
            save_as_new_version=True,
        )

    def test_edit_metadata_without_source_succeeds(self):
        status, body = self.patch(self.second["id"], {
            "title": "夜航·重制（修订）",
            "description": "新的说明\n保留换行",
            "tags": ["民谣", "重制", "2026"],
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        # 返回修改后的完整记录，标识不变，来源不变。
        self.assertEqual(body, {
            "id": self.second["id"],
            "title": "夜航·重制（修订）",
            "source": "/music/yehang.flac",
            "duration": 250,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png",
            "description": "新的说明\n保留换行",
            "tags": ["民谣", "重制", "2026"],
        })

    def test_unsubmitted_fields_keep_old_values(self):
        status, body = self.patch(self.second["id"], {"title": "只改名称"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["duration"], 250)
        self.assertEqual(body["cover_url"], "https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png")
        self.assertEqual(body["description"], "重制说明")
        self.assertEqual(body["tags"], ["民谣", "重制"])
        self.assertEqual(body["source"], "/music/yehang.flac")

    def test_resubmit_current_source_succeeds(self):
        status, body = self.patch(self.first["id"], {
            "source": "/music/yehang.flac",
            "title": "夜航·首版（校对）",
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["id"], self.first["id"])
        self.assertEqual(body["source"], "/music/yehang.flac")
        self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航·首版（校对）")

class EditSourceConflictTest(ServerTestCase):
    """把来源改成其他曲目已使用的文字：拒绝保存且不影响任何记录。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.edited = self.create_track(
            title="待编辑",
            source="/music/edited.flac",
            duration=100,
            cover_url="https://img.example/edited.png",
            description="原始说明",
            tags=["原始"],
        )
        self.occupied_a = self.create_track(
            title="目标来源·版本一", source="/music/taken.flac", duration=1,
        )
        self.occupied_b = self.create_track(
            title="目标来源·版本二", source="/music/taken.flac", duration=2,
            save_as_new_version=True,
        )
        self.bystander = self.create_track(
            title="无关曲目", source="/music/other.flac",
        )

    def test_conflict_returns_409_with_all_occupants(self):
        status, body = self.patch(self.edited["id"], {
            "title": "合法的新名称",
            "source": "/music/taken.flac",
            "duration": 180,
            "description": "合法的新说明",
            "tags": ["合法", "标签"],
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 409, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "source")
        # 目标来源的多个版本全部列出，按标识升序；
        # 不包含正在编辑的曲目，也不包含其他来源的记录。
        self.assertEqual(body["existing"], [
            {"id": self.occupied_a["id"], "title": "目标来源·版本一"},
            {"id": self.occupied_b["id"], "title": "目标来源·版本二"},
        ])

    def test_conflict_leaves_every_record_unchanged(self):
        status, _ = self.patch(self.edited["id"], {
            "title": "合法的新名称",
            "source": "/music/taken.flac",
            "duration": 180,
            "description": "合法的新说明",
            "tags": ["合法", "标签"],
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)

        tracks = self.list_tracks()
        self.assertEqual(len(tracks), 4)
        # 正在编辑的记录仍是提交前的整条资料，没有保存一部分。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.edited["id"]), self.edited)
        # 目标来源的各条记录与无关记录都不受影响。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.occupied_a["id"]), self.occupied_a)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.occupied_b["id"]), self.occupied_b)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.bystander["id"]), self.bystander)

    def test_retry_with_free_source_saves_without_cancelling(self):
        status, _ = self.patch(self.edited["id"], {"source": "/music/taken.flac"})
        self.assertEqual(status, 409)

        # 不取消编辑、不另存版本，直接换成未收录的来源重新提交。
        status, body = self.patch(self.edited["id"], {
            "title": "合法的新名称",
            "source": "/music/fresh.flac",
            "duration": 180,
            "description": "合法的新说明",
            "tags": ["合法", "标签"],
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        self.assertEqual(body, {
            "id": self.edited["id"],
            "title": "合法的新名称",
            "source": "/music/fresh.flac",
            "duration": 180,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/edited.png",
            "description": "合法的新说明",
            "tags": ["合法", "标签"],
        })
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.edited["id"]), body)

    def test_conflict_whitespace_trimmed_before_comparison(self):
        # 目标来源按去掉首尾空白后的文字判断。
        status, body = self.patch(self.edited["id"], {
            "source": "  /music/taken.flac  ",
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 409, body)
        self.assertEqual(len(body["existing"]), 2)

class EditCoverApiCompatibilityTest(ServerTestCase):
    """直接走 JSON 接口收录/编辑封面地址：网页处理不改变接口的换行规则。"""

    def test_api_create_preserves_internal_newline_styles(self):
        for name, cover in (
            ("lf", "https://a/甲\n乙"),
            ("crlf", "https://a/甲\r\n乙"),
            ("cr", "https://a/甲\r乙"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(case=name):
                track = self.create_track(
                    title=f"接口地址-{name}", source=f"/music/{name}.flac",
                    cover_url=cover,
                )
                self.assertEqual(track["cover_url"], cover)
                self.assertEqual(
                    self.track_by_id(track["id"])["cover_url"], cover
                )

    def test_api_patch_cover_trims_outer_but_keeps_inner(self):
        track = self.create_track(
            title="接口编辑", source="/music/api.flac",
            cover_url="https://img.example/old.png",
        )
        status, body = self.patch(track["id"], {
            "cover_url": "  https://img.example/a\r\n  b  \r\n ",
        })
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        # 接口规则不变：只裁整段首尾空白（含末行尾部空白与最后的换行），
        # 内部换行写法（CRLF）与内部行首空格逐字节保留。
        self.assertEqual(
            body["cover_url"], "https://img.example/a\r\n  b"
        )

    def test_api_non_string_cover_rejected(self):
        track = self.create_track(
            title="类型错误", source="/music/type.flac",
            cover_url="https://img.example/old.png",
        )
        status, body = self.patch(track["id"], {"cover_url": 123})
        self.assertEqual(status, 400, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "cover_url")
        self.assertEqual(
            self.track_by_id(track["id"])["cover_url"],
            "https://img.example/old.png",
        )


class SourceApiNewlinePreservationTest(ServerTestCase):
    """接口收录与接口编辑：来源只去首尾空白，内部换行写法逐字节保留。"""

    def test_api_create_preserves_internal_newlines_verbatim(self):
        source = "第一段\r\n第二段\n第三段\r第四段"
        track = self.create_track(title="多行来源", source=source)
        self.assertEqual(track["source"], source)
        # 接口随后读到的来源与保存结果一致。
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(track["id"])["source"], source)

    def test_api_create_strips_only_surrounding_whitespace(self):
        track = self.create_track(
            title="首尾空白", source="\n  内部  保留\r\n换行  \n",
        )
        self.assertEqual(track["source"], "内部  保留\r\n换行")

    def test_api_patch_preserves_internal_newlines_verbatim(self):
        track = self.create_track(title="待改", source="/music/old.flac")
        source = "新的\r\n来源\n文字"
        status, body = self.patch(track["id"], {"source": source})
        self.assertEqual(status, 200, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["source"], source)
        self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(track["id"])["source"], source)


class CreateDuplicateSourceApiTest(ServerTestCase):
    """收录接口（POST /api/tracks）：同一来源默认 409 拒绝，不写入不改旧记录。"""

    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.first = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·首版",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            duration=243.5,
            cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png",
            description="首版说明",
            tags=["民谣", "现场"],
        )
        self.second = self.create_track(
            title="夜航·重制",
            source="/music/yehang.flac",
            duration=250,
            cover_url="https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png",
            description="重制说明",
            tags=["民谣", "重制"],
            save_as_new_version=True,
        )
        self.bystander = self.create_track(
            title="无关曲目", source="/music/other.flac", duration=9,
        )

    def duplicate_payload(self, **overrides):
        payload = {
            "title": "夜航·候选版本",
            "source": " \t/music/yehang.flac\n ",
            "duration": 307.25,
            "cover_url": "https://img.example/candidate.png",
            "description": "候选说明\n与已有记录都不同",
            "tags": ["候选", "新编"],
        }
        payload.update(overrides)
        return payload

    def test_duplicate_source_without_flag_returns_409(self):
        # 来源仅首尾空白不同；名称、说明等资料完全不同也必须拒绝。
        status, body = self.server.request(
            "POST", "/api/tracks", self.duplicate_payload()
        )
        self.assertEqual(status, 409, body)
        self.assertEqual(body["field"], "source")
        # existing 列出该来源的全部已有记录，只含 id 与 title，
        # 按标识升序，不混入其他来源的曲目。
        self.assertEqual(body["existing"], [
            {"id": self.first["id"], "title": "夜航·首版"},
            {"id": self.second["id"], "title": "夜航·重制"},
        ])

    def test_explicit_false_is_also_rejected(self):
        status, body = self.server.request(
            "POST", "/api/tracks",
            self.duplicate_payload(save_as_new_version=False),
        )

成功响应是修改后的完整曲目，更新的仍是原来的标识。 self.assertEqual(body, { "id": self.track_id, "title": "夜航（新版）", "source": "/music/yehang.flac", "duration": 243.5, "cover_url": "https://img.example/yehang.png", "description": "夜航现场录音", "tags": ["民谣", "现场"], }) def test_listed_title_matches_success_response(self): status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": "夜航（定稿）"}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) # 列表中该条记录与成功响应完全一致。 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id), body) self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["title"], "夜航（定稿）" ) def test_rename_adds_no_record_and_keeps_id_ascending_order(self): before_ids = [t["id"] for t in self.list_tracks()] status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": "夜航（修订）"}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) tracks = self.list_tracks() # 不增加曲目，列表仍按标识升序。 self.assertEqual(len(tracks), len(before_ids)) self.assertEqual([t["id"] for t in tracks], before_ids) self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in tracks], sorted(t["id"] for t in tracks), ) self.assertEqual([t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.track_id, self.bystander["id"]]) class EditTitleApiContentRulesTest(ServerTestCase): """PATCH title 按文字保存：只裁整段首尾空白，内部内容与换行写法逐字保留。""" def setUp(self): super().setUp() self.track = self.create_track( title="原名称", source="/music/title.flac", duration=243.5, cover_url="https://img.example/old.png", description="旧说明", tags=["旧标签"], ) self.track_id = self.track["id"] def assert_title_saved_verbatim(self, submitted, expected): """提交 title，断言响应与列表读到的名称都等于 expected。""" status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": submitted}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["id"], self.track_id) self.assertEqual( body["title"], expected, "成功响应的名称与保存结果不一致：\n 实际=%r\n 期望=%r" % (body["title"], expected), ) listed = self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["title"] self.assertEqual( listed, expected, "列表读到的名称与保存结果不一致：\n 实际=%r\n 期望=%r" % (listed, expected), ) return body def test_chinese_quotes_and_angle_brackets_kept_as_plain_text(self): # 中文、中英文引号、尖括号都是名称文字，不转义、不删除、不合并。 title = '夜航 “引号” 与 "双引号" 与 \'单引号\' 不是加粗' self.assert_title_saved_verbatim(title, title) def test_html_looking_text_kept_as_plain_text(self): # 看起来像网页标签的内容按普通文字保存。 title = "<看起来像标签>" self.assert_title_saved_verbatim(title, title) def test_internal_consecutive_spaces_kept(self): # 内部连续空格不能被合并或删除。 self.assert_title_saved_verbatim("夜航 现场 版", "夜航 现场 版") def test_internal_blank_lines_kept(self): # 内部空行（连续换行）是实际内容，不能被折叠。 self.assert_title_saved_verbatim("夜航\n\n现场 版", "夜航\n\n现场 版") self.assert_title_saved_verbatim("夜航\n\n\n空三行后", "夜航\n\n\n空三行后") def test_only_surrounding_whitespace_is_trimmed(self): # 只去掉整段首尾空白（空格、制表符、换行都算）。 self.assert_title_saved_verbatim( " \t 夜航\n现场 版 \n\t ", "夜航\n现场 版" ) def test_lf_newlines_preserved_verbatim(self): # 直接接口提交的 LF 换行原样保存，不做任何统一。 title = "夜航\n\n现场 版\n结尾行" body = self.assert_title_saved_verbatim(title, title) self.assertNotIn("\r", body["title"]) def test_crlf_newlines_preserved_verbatim(self): # 直接接口提交的 CRLF 换行原样保留，不能套用网页表单的 LF 归一化。 title = "夜航\r\n\r\n现场 版\r\n结尾行" body = self.assert_title_saved_verbatim(title, title) self.assertIn("\r\n", body["title"]) self.assertNotIn("\n", body["title"].replace("\r\n", "")) def test_cr_newlines_preserved_verbatim(self): # 直接接口提交的旧式单独 CR 换行也原样保留。 title = "夜航\r现场 版\r结尾行" body = self.assert_title_saved_verbatim(title, title) self.assertIn("\r", body["title"]) self.assertNotIn("\n", body["title"]) def test_mixed_newline_styles_each_preserved(self): # 同一段名称里混用 LF、CRLF、CR 时，三种写法各自保留。 title = "LF 行\n下一行\r\n再一行\rCR 行\n收尾" self.assert_title_saved_verbatim(title, title) def test_newline_style_variants_remain_distinct(self): # 仅换行写法不同的两次改名保存为不同的名称，不会被统一成同一段。 lf_title = "夜航\n现场版" crlf_title = "夜航\r\n现场版" status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": lf_title}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["title"], lf_title) status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": crlf_title}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["title"], crlf_title) self.assertNotEqual( self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["title"], lf_title ) def test_internal_text_change_is_read_back(self): # 用户确实修改名称内部文字后，读回的名称包含本次改动。 self.assert_title_saved_verbatim("夜航·重制版", "夜航·重制版") def test_internal_line_break_change_is_read_back(self): # 用户确实修改名称内部分行后，读回的分行与本次提交一致。 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": "夜航\n现场 版"}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航\n现场 版") status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": "夜航现场 版"}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) # 删去内部分行属于真实改动，读回不再包含换行。 self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航现场 版") self.assertNotIn("\n", body["title"]) class EditTitleApiPartialUpdateTest(ServerTestCase): """局部修改：省略 title 改名不影响名称；只改名称其他资料保留原值。""" def setUp(self): super().setUp() self.track = self.create_track( title="夜航\n现场 版", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration=243.5, cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png", description="旧说明\n第二行", tags=["民谣", "现场"], ) self.track_id = self.track["id"] def test_omitting_title_with_valid_description_keeps_title_bytes(self): new_description = "新的说明\n第二行：鸟鸣" status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, { "description": new_description, }) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) # 省略 title：名称完整保留，包括原有的内部换行写法。 self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航\n现场 版") self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["title"], "夜航\n现场 版" ) self.assertEqual(body["description"], new_description) def test_omitting_title_keeps_crlf_and_cr_newline_styles(self): for name, raw in ( ("crlf", "夜航\r\n现场 版"), ("cr", "夜航\r现场 版"), ): with self.subTest(style=name): track = self.create_track( title=raw, source=f"/music/{name}.flac", ) status, body = self.patch(track["id"], { "description": "只改说明", }) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) # 原有内部换行写法逐字节保留，没有被网页式 LF 归一化影响。 self.assertEqual( body["title"], raw, "名称换行写法被改写：\n 实际=%r\n 原文=%r" % (body["title"], raw), ) self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(track["id"])["title"], raw ) def test_title_only_keeps_all_other_fields(self): new_title = "夜航（新版）" status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": new_title}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["id"], self.track_id) self.assertEqual(body["title"], new_title) # 来源、时长、封面、说明和标签保留原值。 self.assertEqual(body["source"], self.track["source"]) self.assertEqual(body["duration"], self.track["duration"]) self.assertEqual(body["cover_url"], self.track["cover_url"]) self.assertEqual(body["description"], self.track["description"]) self.assertEqual(body["tags"], self.track["tags"]) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id), body) def test_empty_patch_body_changes_nothing(self): status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id), self.track) def test_omitting_title_when_changing_other_fields_round_trips(self): # 省略 title 同时修改多个合法字段，名称仍逐字保留，其余修改生效。 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, { "duration": 300, "tags": ["新标签"], }) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航\n现场 版") self.assertEqual(body["duration"], 300) self.assertEqual(body["tags"], ["新标签"]) # 未提交的来源、封面、说明也仍是原值。 self.assertEqual(body["source"], self.track["source"]) self.assertEqual(body["cover_url"], self.track["cover_url"]) self.assertEqual(body["description"], self.track["description"]) class EditTitleApiSameSourceVersionsTest(ServerTestCase): """同一来源的多个版本：只给其中一个改名不误报冲突，其他版本不受影响。""" def setUp(self): super().setUp() self.first = self.create_track( title="夜航·首版", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration=243.5, cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png", description="首版说明", tags=["民谣", "现场"], ) self.second = self.create_track( title="夜航·重制", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration=250, cover_url="https://img.example/yehang-remaster.png", description="重制说明", tags=["民谣", "重制"], save_as_new_version=True, ) self.other = self.create_track( title="别的来源", source="/music/other.flac", ) def test_rename_one_version_succeeds_without_conflict(self): status, body = self.patch(self.second["id"], { "title": "夜航·重制（修订）", }) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["id"], self.second["id"]) # 来源未改，只改名称不会触发同来源冲突；来源仍是共用的那一个。 self.assertEqual(body["source"], "/music/yehang.flac") self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航·重制（修订）") def test_other_versions_full_records_untouched(self): status, body = self.patch(self.second["id"], { "title": "夜航·重制（修订）", }) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) tracks = self.list_tracks() # 记录数量与列表顺序不变，两个版本仍是各自独立的记录。 self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.first["id"], self.second["id"], self.other["id"]], ) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"]), body) # 同一来源的其他版本名称与完整资料不受影响。 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"]), self.first) # 其他来源的曲目也不受影响。 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.other["id"]), self.other) def test_rename_every_version_independently(self): status, body = self.patch(self.first["id"], {"title": "夜航·首版（定名）"}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航·首版（定名）") status, body = self.patch(self.second["id"], { "title": "夜航·重制\r\n保留 CRLF", }) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航·重制\r\n保留 CRLF") # 两个版本的改名互不干扰，第三个曲目不变。 self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(self.first["id"])["title"], "夜航·首版（定名）" ) self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(self.second["id"])["title"], "夜航·重制\r\n保留 CRLF", ) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.first["id"])["source"], "/music/yehang.flac") self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.second["id"])["source"], "/music/yehang.flac") self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.other["id"]), self.other) class EditTitleApiSameNameRecordsTest(ServerTestCase): """名称相同的不同曲目保持各自标识，改名不会把记录合并。""" def test_same_name_records_keep_distinct_ids(self): first = self.create_track(title="同名曲目", source="/music/a.flac") second = self.create_track(title="同名曲目", source="/music/b.flac") self.assertNotEqual(first["id"], second["id"]) status, body = self.patch(first["id"], {"title": "改了名字的曲目"}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) tracks = self.list_tracks() # 改名后仍是两条独立记录，数量与顺序不变，记录没有被合并。 self.assertEqual(len(tracks), 2) self.assertEqual([t["id"] for t in tracks], [first["id"], second["id"]]) self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(first["id"])["title"], "改了名字的曲目" ) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(second["id"])["title"], "同名曲目") def test_renaming_to_another_tracks_title_does_not_merge(self): first = self.create_track(title="名称甲", source="/music/a.flac") second = self.create_track(title="名称乙", source="/music/b.flac") # 把第一条改成与第二条完全相同的名称：各自标识仍在，不合并。 status, body = self.patch(first["id"], {"title": "名称乙"}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) tracks = self.list_tracks() self.assertEqual(len(tracks), 2) self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in tracks], [first["id"], second["id"]] ) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(first["id"]), body) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(first["id"])["title"], "名称乙") self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(second["id"])["title"], "名称乙") self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(first["id"])["source"], "/music/a.flac" ) self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(second["id"])["source"], "/music/b.flac" ) class EditTitleApiInvalidTest(ServerTestCase): """PATCH title 为空/纯空白/非法类型：400 且 field=title，整单失败不落库。""" def setUp(self): super().setUp() self.track = self.create_track( title="夜航\n现场 版", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration=243.5, cover_url="https://img.example/yehang.png", description="原说明\n第二行", tags=["民谣", "现场"], ) self.track_id = self.track["id"] self.bystander = self.create_track( title="同一来源另一版本", source="/music/yehang.flac", duration=250, description="不应受影响", tags=["其他"], save_as_new_version=True, ) self.other = self.create_track( title="别的来源", source="/music/other.flac", ) def assert_title_rejected(self, payload): status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, payload) self.assertEqual(status, 400, body) # field 指向 title，错误文字说明名称有误。 self.assertEqual(body["field"], "title") self.assertIn("名称", body["error"]) def assert_everything_unchanged(self): tracks = self.list_tracks() # 记录数量与列表按标识升序的顺序保持提交前结果。 self.assertEqual( [t["id"] for t in tracks], [self.track_id, self.bystander["id"], self.other["id"]], ) # 目标曲目完整资料保持提交前内容。 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id), self.track) # 同一来源的其他版本与其他来源曲目都不受影响。 self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.bystander["id"]), self.bystander) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.other["id"]), self.other) def test_empty_string_is_rejected(self): self.assert_title_rejected({"title": ""}) self.assert_everything_unchanged() def test_whitespace_only_strings_are_rejected(self): for bad in (" ", " ", "\t", "\t\t ", "\n", "\r", "\r\n", " \t\n\r ", "\n\n \t\n"): with self.subTest(bad=bad): self.assert_title_rejected({"title": bad}) self.assert_everything_unchanged() def test_null_is_rejected(self): # 名称没有“清空”语义：null 也是名称错误，不能保存为空。 self.assert_title_rejected({"title": None}) self.assert_everything_unchanged() def test_number_types_are_rejected(self): for bad in (0, 1, 243, 243.5, -3): with self.subTest(bad=bad): self.assert_title_rejected({"title": bad}) self.assert_everything_unchanged() def test_booleans_are_rejected(self): for bad in (True, False): with self.subTest(bad=bad): self.assert_title_rejected({"title": bad}) self.assert_everything_unchanged() def test_array_and_object_are_rejected(self): for bad in ([], ["夜航"], {}, {"title": "夜航"}): with self.subTest(bad=bad): self.assert_title_rejected({"title": bad}) self.assert_everything_unchanged() def test_invalid_title_with_valid_description_saves_nothing(self): # 即使同次请求还提交了合法的新说明（以及其他合法资料），也不能 # 先保存说明或其他部分内容：整条记录保持提交前状态。 self.assert_title_rejected({ "title": " ", "description": "不应保存的新说明", "duration": 300, "tags": ["不应保存的新标签"], }) self.assert_everything_unchanged() self.assertEqual( self.track_by_id(self.track_id)["description"], "原说明\n第二行" ) def test_null_title_alongside_other_changes_saves_nothing(self): self.assert_title_rejected({ "title": None, "description": "不应保存的新说明", }) self.assert_everything_unchanged() def test_repeated_failures_leave_no_partial_change(self): # 连续多种非法名称后，列表中仍是提交前的记录与原名称。 for bad in ("", " \n\t", None, 123, True, ["x"], {"k": "v"}): with self.subTest(bad=bad): self.assert_title_rejected({ "title": bad, "description": "反复失败时不应保存的说明", }) self.assert_everything_unchanged() def test_legal_request_after_rejection_saves_normally(self): # 非法名称被拒后，用同一标识提交合法名称可正常保存； # 失败请求里尝试一起改的说明不会被补入。 status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, { "title": None, "description": "失败请求里的新说明", }) self.assertEqual(status, 400, body) self.assertEqual(body["field"], "title") status, body = self.patch(self.track_id, {"title": "夜航（定稿）"}) self.assertEqual(status, 200, body) self.assertEqual(body["title"], "夜航（定稿）") # 说明没有被失败请求改动，其余资料也保持原值。 self.assertEqual(body["description"], "原说明\n第二行") self.assertEqual(body["source"], self.track["source"]) self.assertEqual(body["duration"], self.track["duration"]) self.assertEqual(body["cover_url"], self.track["cover_url"]) self.assertEqual(body["tags"], self.track["tags"]) self.assertEqual(self.track_by_id(self.track_id), body) if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()

## 新增内容

在文件末尾、`__main__` 之前新增 6 个测试类（35 个用例），全部通过子进程真实启动服务、走 HTTP JSON 接口验证：

| 测试类 | 固定的规则 |
| --- | --- |
| `EditTitleApiValidRenameTest` | 合法新名称返回 **200 与完整曲目**、标识不变；列表该条与成功响应一致；不增加曲目、列表保持按 id 升序 |
| `EditTitleApiContentRulesTest` | 名称**只裁整段首尾空白**；中文、引号、尖括号、形似标签的文字按普通文字保存；内部连续空格与空行不折叠；接口提交的 **LF / CRLF / 单独 CR 各自逐字节保留**（明确区别于网页表单的换行归一化）；内部文字或分行确实改动后读回包含改动 |
| `EditTitleApiPartialUpdateTest` | 省略 `title` 只改合法说明时，名称（含原有 LF/CRLF/CR 换行写法）完整保留；只提交新名称时来源、时长、封面、说明、标签全部保留原值；空 PATCH 不变 |
| `EditTitleApiSameSourceVersionsTest` | 多个版本共用同一来源时单独改名成功、不误报 409，其他版本名称与完整资料不受影响 |
| `EditTitleApiSameNameRecordsTest` | 同名曲目（以及改成与他人同名）保持各自标识，改名不合并记录、来源不串 |
| `EditTitleApiInvalidTest` | 空串、纯空格/制表符/换行、`null`、数字、布尔值、数组、对象均返回 **400、`field="title"`、错误文字含“名称”**；同次请求里的合法新说明/时长/标签不先落库；目标曲目、同来源其他版本及其他曲目的完整资料、数量、列表顺序全部保持提交前状态；拒绝后再提交合法名称正常保存 |

同时在模块 docstring 的“编辑”部分补了一段与这些用例对应的说明。既有的网页名称相关测试（编辑页多行名称渲染/未改动保留/改动保存/失败回填、首页收录多行名称等）原样保留。
